name: dsp_write_byte_blocking
desc: Writes a command or data byte to the DSP write-buffer port (polling without timeout)
details: Saves the byte to write in AH, then continuously polls the DSP write-buffer status port (DX) until bit 7 is clear (meaning the DSP write buffer is ready/not busy). Once ready, restores the byte from AH and outputs it to DX. Unlike other DSP write routines, this does not have a timeout counter.

params.name: val
params.desc: Byte value (command or data) to write to the DSP

0823:0c7e.comment: Wait until DSP write buffer is ready (bit 7 clear)
0823:0c7e.label: poll_dsp_ready

0823:0c7a.comment: Save byte to write in AH

0823:0c83.comment: Restore byte and write to DSP
